decisions.decision: The project name for the RFS will be Lunenburg School Project.
decisions.quote: the name of the projects for the rfs will be lunenburg school project.

decisions.decision: The RFS will be advertised in the Central Register and a local newspaper rather than the Boston Globe; the local paper selected is the Worcester Telegram & Gazette.
decisions.quote: the sbc requested the rfs be advertised in the central register and a local newspaper, rather than the boston globe.

decisions.decision: The pre-proposal onsite briefing is confirmed for 12/04/12 at 3:00 PM at LHS.
decisions.quote: the pre-proposal onsite briefing was confirmed for 12/04/12 at 3:00 pm at lhs.

decisions.decision: The advertised milestones remain as listed in the milestone schedules.
decisions.quote: the milestone schedules listed on page 5 & 6 were discussed with the advertised milestones remaining as listed.

decisions.decision: The RFS proposal will be issued from the JLA website with a link to the Lunenburg website.
decisions.quote: the rfs proposal will be issued from jla website with link to lunenburg website.

decisions.decision: Eight members were appointed to the Project Coordination Group, which meets regularly during the school day, with an open invitation to anyone wishing to participate.
decisions.quote: eight (8) members were appointed to the group with an open invitation to anyone else wishing to participate in any meeting.

decisions.decision: Comments or changes on the Site and Design Alternatives matrix are to be directed to JLA for correction and collection.
decisions.quote: comments or changes should be directed to jla for correction and collection.

decisions.decision: Next LSBC meeting topics: construction delivery methods, set-up of public forum, and review criteria and options on the evaluation matrix.
decisions.quote: jla recommend at the next lsbc meeting the following topics be discussed: construction delivery methods, set-up of public forum, and review criteria and options on the evaluation matrix.

decisions.decision: Next meeting set for Monday, December 17, 7:00 PM in the Thomas C. Passios School, Room 13.
decisions.quote: the next meeting will be on monday, december 17, 7:00 pm in the thomas c. passios school, room 13
